relevance.rationale: Relevant but partly superseded inside the corpus already, and I want to be exact about that. QOU's prop:phi-q-aj-machinery-identification carries the AJ conjecture as a conditional-class input; references.ts already holds le2006 ('The colored Jones polynomial and the A-polynomial of knots'), whose note records that it PROVES AJ for a large class of two-bridge knots including all twist knots — strictly stronger than Takata's result, which the abstract itself describes only as 'supports the AJ conjecture'. (le2006 is itself a bib orphan: it exists in references.ts and is cited by no block.) So the AJ-backing value of this paper is low. Its distinctive, non-duplicated value is computational: it writes Masbaum's twist-knot colored-Jones formula in a rearranged normalisation with the three explicit summand ratios f_0, f_1, f_2, and gives the root-of-unity evaluation. computations/aj_masbaum_crosscheck.py cross-checks the QOU 4_1 (= K_{-1}) and trefoil (= K_1) towers against Masbaum, and its own docstring records a prior mis-attribution in that area — an independent second published transcription of the same coefficients is exactly what such a script wants.

keyResults.statement: Masbaum's colored Jones formula for the twist knot K_p, J_{K_p}(n) = sum_k C_{K_p}(k) {n-k}...{n+k}/{n} with C_{K_p}(k) explicit, rearranged so that the summand F(n,k,l) has closed-form ratios f_0 = F(n+1,k,l)/F(n,k,l), f_1 = F(n,k+1,l)/F(n,k,l), f_2 = F(n,k,l+1)/F(n,k,l).
keyResults.useForFolio: An independently published transcription of the same twist-knot coefficients that computations/aj_masbaum_crosscheck.py checks the QOU 4_1 and trefoil towers against, in a different normalisation — so agreement is a genuine second witness against transcription error, which that script's docstring shows is a real failure mode here.

keyResults.statement: Setting q = 1 in the summand recurrences and solving f_0 = l, f_1 = f_2 = 1 recovers a polynomial B_{K_p}(l,m) equal to the A-polynomial A_{K_p}(l,m); §4 additionally derives the A-polynomials of 5_2 and 6_1 from explicit colored-Jones recursions.
keyResults.useForFolio: Concrete worked instances of the classical limit of the AJ machinery that prop:phi-q-aj-machinery-identification describes abstractly. Weaker than le2006, so the honest action is to cite le2006 at that block and keep this as the explicit-computation companion.

keyResults.statement: Explicit evaluation hat-J_{K_p}(n) of the twist-knot colored Jones at q = exp(2 pi i / n), stated for the volume conjecture 2 pi lim (log|hat-J_K(n)|/n) = Vol(M_K).
keyResults.useForFolio: A directly runnable formula for the Kashaev/volume-conjecture asymptotic on 4_1 = K_{-1}, whose Vol(4_1) = 2*Cl_2(pi/3) is the CAL-2 numerical anchor. A finite-n numeric cross-check of Vol(4_1) from this formula is a falsifiable compute-check; it must NOT be used to adopt or re-derive the anchor value.

proposedActions.rationale: Orphan (references.ts has Ohtsuki-Takata 2015 only, a different paper). Low priority: its AJ content is superseded by the already-present le2006; register it for the explicit twist-knot recurrences.

Cross-check the QOU 4_1 / trefoil colored-Jones towers against Takata's rearranged Masbaum normalisation (eqs. 1-5) as an independent second transcription; the script's docstring documents a prior mis-attribution in exactly this area.

Separate finding surfaced by this read: le2006 already exists in references.ts, proves AJ for all twist knots, and is cited by NO block — while prop:phi-q-aj-machinery-identification carries AJ as an unsourced conditional-class input. The right fix is to cite le2006 there.

relevance.rationale: Same subject area as the corpus's AJ machinery (prop:phi-q-aj-machinery-identification, QOU/Machinery/StrongAJFigureEight.lean, QOU/BraidKnot/AJFigureEight*.lean) and its twist-knot cyclotomic work (masbaum2003, bean xcyc). Its AJ-support claim is weaker than what the corpus already has: le2006 (math/0407521, already registered) PROVES the AJ conjecture for a large class of two-bridge knots including all twist knots, whereas Takata only shows the A-polynomial is recoverable from recursions of the SUMMAND of Masbaum's formula. What is genuinely usable is the explicit Hoste-Shanahan A-polynomial data it reproduces (Thm 3.1), including the closed A_{4_1} and A_{trefoil}, which the corpus currently reads off the CCGLS A-polynomial by hand in qbeta_nz_even_series_fourone_probe.py. Not load-bearing; a cross-check source.

keyResults.statement: A_{K_p}(l,m) obeys the two-term recursion A_{K_p} = c A_{K_{p-1}} - d A_{K_{p-2}} with c = -l + l^2 + 2lm^2 + m^4 + 2lm^4 + l^2 m^4 + 2lm^6 + m^8 - lm^8, d = m^4 (l+m^2)^4, and explicit seeds A_{K_1} = l + m^6 (trefoil), A_{K_{-1}} = -l + lm^2 + m^4 + 2lm^4 + l^2 m^4 + lm^6 - lm^8 (figure-eight).
keyResults.useForFolio: Independent published source for the 4_1 A-polynomial that qbeta_nz_even_series_fourone_probe.py uses to recognise the leading longitude coefficient tau = (0, -+1, 1); lets the probe cite a value instead of asserting it, and supplies the whole twist-knot family if the tau extraction is ever run past 4_1.

keyResults.statement: For the twist knot K_p, B_{K_p}(l,m) built from the recursion h_p(m,x) of the summand of Masbaum's colored-Jones formula equals A_{K_p}(l,m).
keyResults.useForFolio: Concrete worked route from a cyclotomic-summand recursion to the A-polynomial, the same shape as the corpus's qZeilberger-telescope annihilation arguments in QOU/BraidKnot/AJFigureEightAnnihilation.lean; usable as a citable precedent for the summand-level (rather than sum-level) recursion technique.

proposedActions.rationale: No ref() entry; the folio has an AJ/twist-knot cluster (garoufalidis2004, le2006, masbaum2003, hikami2004) this belongs in, and the A-polynomial seeds are worth a citable home.
The probe's tau extraction currently reads the CCGLS A-polynomial without a cited value; check the probe's A_{4_1} against Takata's A_{K_{-1}} seed coefficient-by-coefficient.
